name: DescribeContainerGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The zone where the instance is located. If you leave this parameter empty, the system selects a zone.

The default value is empty
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属的可用区。如果取值为空，则表示由系统选择。

默认值为空
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual switch to which the instance is connected
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的虚拟交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The token that marks the start of the next query. If this parameter is empty, no more results are returned.

You do not need to set this parameter for the first query. The token for a subsequent query is obtained from the response to the previous query
parameters.help_zh:
下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。

首次查询时无需设置该参数，后续查询的Token从返回结果中获取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of resources to return. If you do not set this parameter, the default value is 20. The maximum value is 20.

The number of returned resources may be less than but will not be greater than the specified value
parameters.help_zh:
限定此次返回资源的数量。如果不设置，默认返回20个，最大不能超过20个。

返回结果可能小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instances. You can specify up to 20 IDs. The value must be a JSON-formatted string
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID序列。最多20个，字符串需按照JSON格式传入
parameters.name: container_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance, which is also the name of the container group
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称，即容器组名称
parameters.name: container_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

Pending: The instance is starting.

Running: The instance is running.

Succeeded: The instance ran successfully.

Failed: The instance failed to run.

Scheduling: The instance is being created.

ScheduleFailed: The instance failed to be created.

Restarting: The instance is being restarted.

Updating: The instance is being updated.

Terminating: The instance is being stopped.

Expired: The instance has expired
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态。取值范围：

Pending：启动中
Running：运行中
Succeeded：运行成功
Failed：运行失败
Scheduling：创建中
ScheduleFailed：创建失败
Restarting：重启中
Updating：更新中
Terminating：终止中
Expired：过期
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return event information
parameters.name: with_event

fields.help_en: The tag key of the instance
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the instance
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The computing power category. Valid values:

economy: economy

general: general-purpose
parameters.help_zh:
指定算力类别。取值范围：

economy：经济型
general：通用型
parameters.name: compute_category

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs
parameters.name: security_group_id
